newsitem.title: UK: Feb Brent crude throughput down in February.
newsitem.headline: Feb Brent crude throughput down in February.

text.p: Operator Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Wednesday estimated North Sea Brent crude oil system throughput in February at 479,667 barrels per day (bpd), down from January's 520,745 bpd.
Average Brent pipeline throughput for 1996 was 483,784 bpd, Shell Expro said.
The figure is only for Brent and not for the Ninian crude system which is also piped to the Sullom Voe terminal to be mixed with Brent to create North Sea benchmark Brent Blend.
Shell Expro, a joint venture between the Royal Dutch /Shell Group and Exxon Corp, said the forecast was preliminary and may be "subject to significant fluctuation."
